notes: Editor-first layout. The app now opens straight into the full-screen editor (default view = Timeline). Removed the redundant 'Create' tab. 'Text to Video' (paste a script → auto-generate every scene) is no longer a tab — it's a modal opened from a '✨ Text to Video' button in both the tab bar and the editor's top bar, so first-time users land in the workspace. Remaining tabs: Scenes / Media Library / Settings. (Fixed the setAppLang tab-label map that still referenced the old 5 tabs.)
